Add a `model_state_hook.py` Claude Code hook that snapshots the agent's live model/effort/fast for the chat model bar.

Claude's `settings.json` only records the model/fast *preference*; when fast mode is unavailable at runtime (credits exhausted) or Claude auto-falls-back to another model, that is never written down. This hook writes a durable `$MNGR_AGENT_STATE_DIR/claude_model_state.json` snapshot holding the effective state: at Stop and after every tool call (PostToolUse) it reads the transcript's last assistant message for the model actually run and its `service_tier` (the real fast state); before a turn (SessionStart/UserPromptSubmit) it uses the settings preference, since a bar-driven switch has already updated settings but not yet the transcript. Effort comes from settings (it is not in the transcript). The hook is wired into SessionStart, UserPromptSubmit, PostToolUse, and Stop (first, before the blocking stop-hook wait), guarded to the main session and invoked with `|| true` so it can never break Claude's hook chain. The system-interface Claude model resolver reads this snapshot.
